text: Matrix Fitness is the commercial fitness brand of Johnson Health Tech (JHT), the Taiwanese equipment group, per JHT's own press release; the Chile Rugby gym and shorts sponsorship was announced by Matrix Fitness Chile.
short: Matrix Fitness is Johnson Health Tech's commercial brand.

source.quote: Matrix Fitness (www.matrixfitness.com) is the fastest growing commercial brand in the world and is the commercial brand of Johnson Health Tech.
